name: AI for Freelancers: 50 Prompts to Land and Keep Clients
description:
Stop staring at a blank page every time a client needs a message.

AI for Freelancers is a 16-page PDF with 50 ready-to-use prompts for ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or any AI chat tool. Copy a prompt, fill in the highlighted brackets with your details, and get a solid first draft in seconds.

What's inside (50 prompts in 8 sections)

  • Find Clients (6): pick a niche, build a target list, check a prospect fast
  • Outreach and Pitching (7): cold emails, subject lines, follow-ups, LinkedIn notes
  • Proposals and Pricing (7): one-page proposals, three-tier pricing, handling "too expensive", raising your rates
  • Discovery Calls (5): call prep, budget questions, red-flag checks, same-day follow-ups
  • Delivering the Work (6): kickoff emails, weekly updates, saying no to extra work, handover notes
  • Getting Paid (5): invoice emails, polite and firm reminders, payment terms, deposits
  • Reviews and Referrals (5): testimonial and referral requests, case studies
  • Positioning and Productivity (9): your bio, service page, portfolio copy, weekly plan, monthly review

Who it's for: freelancers and solo service providers who want to spend less time on admin messages and more time on client work.

Good to know: prompts help you draft faster. They don't guarantee clients or income, and they aren't legal, tax, or financial advice.
